FALSIFICATION_CRITERION: H1 falsified for this intervention if: PRESENT recall < 0.70 OR false_evidence_entry_rate_on_none > 0.05 OR ordinary NONE→PRESENT > 22 OR (threshold_grid n_passing = 0 AND PRESENT→NONE median P(NONE) >= 0.80).
FORMULA: p = softmax(logits); p_t = p[y]; base_ce = class_weight[y] * provenance_multiplier * (-log p_t); focal = (1 - p_t)^gamma * base_ce; batch_loss = mean(focal over examples). No focal alpha. gamma frozen at 2.0.
SUPPORT_CRITERION: One train on unchanged V1R8 with only focal loss: false_evidence_entry_rate_on_none <= 0.05 AND PRESENT recall >= 0.70 AND threshold_grid n_passing >= 1 AND PRESENT→NONE median P(NONE) < 0.80 AND ordinary NONE→PRESENT <= 22 (2× Stage-A-002 remediated count 11; pre-V1R8 was 60).
